This order charged the city’s regulatory agencies with reviewing their most common violations and identifying reforms to reduce the regulatory burden on small businesses. These savings would not have been possible without the support of this City Council through the passage of Local Law 151 of 2023. Through Executive Order 15, Mayor Adams also launched the Small Business Advisory Commission, or SBAC. This advisory council composed of small business leaders and community stakeholders from across the five boroughs is tasked with proposing further opportunities to cut red tape and improve business services. SBAC has successfully advocated for changes to the administrative rule-making process,
